playerwon.dataset: dataset-specific; must be recorded per import
playerwon.license: PlayerWON Data Use & Citation policy updated 2026-11-13; free commercial analysis/adaptation/sharing only for PlayerWON-created datasets and original analytics; third-party rights excluded
playerwon.attributionText: PlayerWON — cite the exact dataset/page, URL, access date and seasons/filters.
playerwon.thirdPartyOrigin: mixed; PlayerWON states that its permission only covers rights it controls
playerwon.retentionRule: Policy instructs users to retain a copy of the download used for analysis; long-term storage/retention inside a distributed game is not separately specified. Dataset-level review required.
playerwon.automatedAccessAllowed: CSV exports are provided; no blanket automated-import/API permission confirmed. Use manual CSV export only; do not scrape preview pages.
playerwon.notes: PlayerWON's own xG V1 output is an original PlayerWON analytic, but the shot events and identifiers derive from NHL feeds. Its policy does not grant upstream NHL rights. Do not integrate any NHL PlayerWON field until third-party rights and product retention are confirmed.

fastrhockey.license: MIT applies to fastRhockey package code only; SportsDataverse release store declares CC BY 4.0 for data, but each release retains its upstream source restrictions
fastrhockey.thirdPartyOrigin: NHL, ESPN, HockeyTech and other upstream providers depending on endpoint
fastrhockey.retentionRule: No commercial retention right established for NHL/ESPN/HockeyTech upstream data.
fastrhockey.automatedAccessAllowed: Package functions and public releases do not create blanket automation rights. Check each upstream API; do not scrape or bypass limits.
fastrhockey.notes: fastRhockey code may be used under MIT with its notice. NHL wrappers call api-web.nhle.com and api.nhle.com/stats; PWHL/AHL/CHL/European/NCAA endpoints have separate upstreams. Do not import data until endpoint-specific rights are confirmed.

hockey_db.retentionRule: No restriction stated in public-domain declaration
hockey_db.notes: OpenSport hockey.db remains public-domain, but the inspected 2015-16 file is a schedule fixture, not player ratings or current rosters.

ehlersio_nhl_contracts.thirdPartyOrigin: Source references may have separate rights; preserve provenance
ehlersio_nhl_contracts.notes: CC0 contract source and existing importer are already in the project. Contracts/salaries/cap hits are treated as completed; this audit does not reopen that work.

moneypuck.license: Official page: free for non-commercial purposes and journalists for ad-hoc use only; other use not authorized by the published free terms.
moneypuck.notes: Still excluded. Current page lists 2,079,359 historical shots (2007-08 through 2025-26) and 2026-27 shots, but the license remains non-commercial/journalism only. Do not copy its xG outputs or model coefficients.

evolving_hockey.license: Personal-use-only data and content; no mirroring, bot/spider or manual copying; models built from site data may be shared publicly with a link back, but that does not grant commercial product use.
evolving_hockey.notes: Still excluded. Do not copy RAPM/GAR/xGAR tables, coefficients, datasets or model outputs into Hockey Dynasty.

nhl_edge.license: NHL Terms of Service last updated 2025-10-29; Services/content are for private non-commercial use and may not be distributed, modified or used to create derivative works.
nhl_edge.notes: Still excluded. Public endpoint availability is not a commercial license; no NHL/EDGE data in the commercial pipeline.

hockey_databank.license: Hockey Databank project custom free-use notice; explicitly permits a commercial product based on its data subject to prominent verbatim attribution and accuracy disclaimer
hockey_databank.attributionText: The information used herein was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by the Hockey Databank project. For more information about the Hockey Databank project please visit http://sports.groups.yahoo.com/group/hockey-databank
hockey_databank.thirdPartyOrigin: Version 13.0 lists NHL guides/record books, books, periodicals and online references. The project claims copyright in its database and grants use, but underlying source rights are not itemized individually.
hockey_databank.retentionRule: No explicit retention period or storage clause is stated. Commercial product use is expressly permitted, but production retention remains pending strict review.
hockey_databank.automatedAccessAllowed: CSV files are publicly downloadable through GitHub. No source-specific scheduled automation clause was found; use direct repository downloads/API only, respect GitHub limits, no scraping of unrelated sites.
hockey_databank.notes: Historical-only: version 13.0 dated 2018-07-10, data updated through 2017-18. Includes biographical fields and season scoring/goaltending, not shot coordinates, tracking or shifts. Do not redistribute raw CSVs; exact attribution must be implemented before product use.

wikidata.license: CC0 for all structured data in main, Property, Lexeme and EntitySchema namespaces
wikidata.thirdPartyOrigin: Community-contributed structured statements released under CC0; preserve item-level references for data quality and provenance.
wikidata.automatedAccessAllowed: Official Wikidata APIs and dumps; use descriptive User-Agent, serial requests, gzip, caching, maxlag and backoff.
wikidata.notes: Approved for structured identity/biographical metadata only (e.g. identifiers, birth data, positions, nationality, height when present). Coverage and accuracy must be audited; not a roster authority or player-performance dataset. No photos, team logos or trademarks are included.

wikipedia.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 and, for most text, GFDL; article/table reuse must follow the page's actual licensing and source notices
wikipedia.thirdPartyOrigin: Contributor-created team-season and player-career tables; individual pages may contain imported material or separate notices that must be checked.
wikipedia.retentionRule: No retention period is stated in the license; retain page/revision URL, attribution, license notice and modification history. Adapted material shared downstream must be under CC BY-SA 4.0 or compatible terms.
wikipedia.automatedAccessAllowed: Use MediaWiki Action API or official dumps, not page scraping; descriptive User-Agent, serial requests, maxlag and caching.
wikipedia.notes: Commercial use is allowed, but share-alike obligations may extend to adapted tables/data. Do not feed Wikipedia-derived stats into proprietary ratings until the downstream data/ratings licensing treatment is decided. Do not reuse article images or logos under the text license.

sportsdataverse_data.license: SportsDataverse release store declares CC BY 4.0 for data; fastRhockey package code is MIT. NHL releases identify api-web.nhle.com as upstream source.
sportsdataverse_data.thirdPartyOrigin: NHL public API (api-web.nhle.com); upstream NHL terms govern NHL-owned content.
sportsdataverse_data.retentionRule: No commercial storage or retention right established from the upstream NHL terms; exclude from production.
sportsdataverse_data.automatedAccessAllowed: Release assets are publicly downloadable, but public GitHub access and CC BY 4.0 cannot override upstream NHL restrictions. No commercial automated ingestion.
sportsdataverse_data.notes: CC BY 4.0 may cover SportsDataverse-controlled material but does not grant rights to NHL-owned upstream content. NHL Terms of Service restrict the Services and content to private non-commercial use and prohibit derivatives. The nhl_xg_models tag is listed as an unattributed release with no public producer; do not use its weights.

ice_hockey_api.license: Terms last updated 2026-10-09; free key permits use of API results in own apps/sites and display to own users, but no bulk redistribution/republication or bulk database rebuilding
ice_hockey_api.thirdPartyOrigin: Provider API; underlying data provenance and rights are not fully itemized in the terms reviewed.
ice_hockey_api.retentionRule: No explicit long-term storage or retention permission located; no bulk replication.
ice_hockey_api.automatedAccessAllowed: API only; free key limited to 50 calls/day and 10/minute. Multiple keys, rotating keys and website automation are prohibited; do not scrape pages.
ice_hockey_api.notes: Free key is $0/no card. The plan comparison table limits it to yesterday's games, scores, standings, playoffs, goals and three stars; it excludes lineups, player/goalie lines and play-by-play. The pricing bullets conflict on boxscore/play-by-play, so treat that scope as uncertain. Not a source for player ratings.

big_data_cup_2026.license: Stathletes Public Data User Agreement; research produced from the dataset may be shared publicly only if it is not used for profit
big_data_cup_2026.thirdPartyOrigin: Stathletes-tracked events and player tracking generated from broadcast video.
big_data_cup_2026.retentionRule: No commercial retention or product use; agreement is research/non-profit only.
big_data_cup_2026.automatedAccessAllowed: Public GitHub release download, but the agreement does not permit profit-oriented research or commercial product use.
big_data_cup_2026.notes: Useful event/shift/tracking fields for research, but explicitly non-profit only. Do not use for commercial xG, GSAx, RAPM/GAR or player ratings.

score_sports_data.license: No dataset license or commercial reuse grant found on the source page; dataset collected using hockeyR from NHL event data
score_sports_data.thirdPartyOrigin: NHL event data accessed through hockeyR; NHL Terms of Service apply to upstream content.
score_sports_data.retentionRule: No commercial storage/retention right established; do not download/import for the commercial product.
score_sports_data.automatedAccessAllowed: A public CSV download is linked, but no reuse license or automated access grant is published.
score_sports_data.notes: Contains 160,573 shot records for 2021-22 with x/y, distance, angle and outcome. Technically suitable for an xG prototype, but not legally cleared for commercial use.

hockey_databank_historical.dataset: Hockey Databank v13.0 historical player biography, season scoring and goaltending through 2017-18
hockey_databank_historical.reason: The project explicitly allows a commercial product based on its data with a full prominent attribution and accuracy disclaimer. However, the custom notice does not separately specify long-term product retention, the public mirror is third-party, and the source list is mixed. Keep blocked until retention/provenance review is complete and the exact credit is implemented.

wikidata_hockey_player_metadata.dataset: Wikidata structured player identity and biographical metadata
wikidata_hockey_player_metadata.reason: All structured Wikidata data is released under CC0. Suitable for metadata and identity matching only; item coverage, accuracy and source references still require validation.

wikipedia_nhl_season_stats.dataset: English Wikipedia NHL team-season and player-career statistics tables, 2018-19 through last completed season
wikipedia_nhl_season_stats.reason: CC BY-SA 4.0 permits commercial reuse and adaptation with attribution, but adapted material that is shared must be licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 or compatible terms. Hockey Dynasty has not decided/implemented share-alike for source-derived data and ratings.

sportsdataverse_nhl_pbp_full.dataset: NHL full-detail play-by-play release (2010-2027), source NHL public API
sportsdataverse_nhl_pbp_full.reason: Although the release store declares CC BY 4.0 for its data, this release explicitly identifies the NHL public API as upstream. NHL Terms of Service limit service content to private non-commercial use and prohibit derivatives.

sportsdataverse_nhl_xg_models.reason: The release is listed as unattributed with no public producer; model provenance, weights license, training data rights and commercial use are not established. Do not copy model weights.

ice_hockey_api_free_scores.dataset: Free-key yesterday game scores, standings, goals and three stars
ice_hockey_api_free_scores.reason: Terms permit display of API results in own apps/sites but do not expressly confirm commercial use or long-term retention. Bulk redistribution and database rebuilding are prohibited; free-tier plan scope is limited and pricing bullets conflict with the comparison table.

big_data_cup_2026_tracking.dataset: Stathletes event, shift and broadcast-derived player tracking data
big_data_cup_2026_tracking.reason: The published Stathletes agreement restricts research outputs to non-profit use. No commercial product, training or derived metrics for profit.

score_nhl_shots_2021_22.reason: No dataset license is published on the page; the dataset was collected from NHL event data using hockeyR, whose upstream NHL terms do not authorize commercial derivatives.

playerwon_nhl_xg_aggregates.reason: PlayerWON policy covers its original analytics for free commercial analysis/adaptation/sharing, but its xG is calculated from NHL shot events. The policy does not grant upstream NHL rights, and long-term game retention is not explicit. Keep blocked pending source-level rights and attribution.
